Do you have a minute to read this?
| | |
---
Friend, this message is a bit on the longer side, but I hope you'll take the time to read it. **[You see, in a lot of ways, this campaign is a love letter to Florida.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86594434/478395237/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1341-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmQ3ZTU2NDgtYzEyNi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=7oFN-Qd9StrkNiorKBnT4G3izEPD5Zo9Y7XQOckKd0A=)**
I can still remember the first time that I came to Florida. I was working on my master's degree and had just gotten the news that my beloved father had been killed by a criminal with a gun in Ecuador, where I was born. As I grappled with my grief, I found myself missing Ecuador more than I had in years. I missed its warmth, lush greenery, and close-knit communities that I grew up with. My older sister, Monica, knew our family was struggling, so she convinced me to visit her in Miami, where she had recently moved.
When I stepped outside of the airport, it was like stepping into another world. **It was warm, wonderfully humid, bustling with lively, diverse communities, lush, and all so, so beautifully green.** We spent the next few days visiting all of Monica's favorite places in her new city — the spots with the most beautiful views and the best cafes to get a _cafecito_. The people we met were even warmer than the weather. Everyone was welcoming, friendly, and proud to call this state their home.
I boarded my plane back to my home with a heavy heart but a new resolve. **As soon as I was able, I sold my car and moved across the country to live in a one room apartment in America.**(My mom, always my closest confidant, wasn't far behind.)
Since moving here all those years ago, I've had the privilege to build a beautiful life in the Sunshine State. **I fell in love here, found the community I had longed for, raised a family of my own, and dedicated my career to serving this state.** I've helped protect the Everglades, expanded access to health care, worked for Florida International University, and became the first South American immigrant elected to Congress, right here in Florida.
I've spent my life serving this state and getting to know the communities who call it home. But my opponent, Rick Scott, has spent his career scamming Floridians, lying to voters, and making himself richer. **He wants you to think that Florida families agree with his extreme, hateful agenda._But I can promise you, friend, that couldn't be further from the truth._**
Listen, my campaign is deeply personal because of my love for this state — and more importantly, because of what it will mean for my fellow Floridians. Rick Scott wants to sow division and undo decades of meaningful progress. He wants to destroy reproductive rights, gun safety laws, and vital public services, like Medicare and Social Security, that support millions of his constituents, including my own mother.

Florida is ready for a change — I hear it from voters every day as I travel around all 67 counties. I know this November, Floridians will choose unity, progress, and kindness over Rick Scott's extremist agenda.

But the truth is, we're up against a mega-millionaire who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time. If we're going to break through Rick Scott's lies, build unstoppable grassroots momentum, and win this critical race, I'll need your help.

**[Please, will you donate $5 (or whatever you can spare today) to help me defeat Rick Scott and give our home the leadership that we deserve? This _will_ be the year that we flip Florida blue, but only if grassroots activists like _you_ believe in my campaign.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86594435/478395238/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1341-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmQ3ZTU2NDgtYzEyNi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=7oFN-Qd9StrkNiorKBnT4G3izEPD5Zo9Y7XQOckKd0A=)**

body:
The decision to run against Senator Menendez was one of the most consequential decisions of my life.
| Friend,

I'm officially the Democratic Nominee for Senate in New Jersey. [_I’m humbly asking for your support by splitting a donation between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project to help us keep this seat blue and retake the Senate Majority._](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70000?t=6&akid=15018%2E878179%2ElPGGRC) [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70000?t=7&akid=15018%2E878179%2ElPGGRC) The decision to run against Senator Menendez was one of the most consequential decisions of my life. The reason I stepped up is because I’m tired of constantly watching our politics fail our nation. We are just cycling from crisis to crisis, and too many politicians aren’t focused on what the American people need help with.

**Right now, a staggering 84 percent of people in New Jersey believe NJ politicians are corrupt.** The people of New Jersey deserve a choice for what kind of public servant they have in the Senate.

Instead of throwing up my hands and giving up, I am stepping up to show that there is a better way. We deserve leaders who can serve with integrity. Leaders who are workhorses, not show horses. After Menendez’s scandal, we need a fresh new start — a chance to lift up a new generation of leadership that can bring a new voice and deep public service experience to the U.S. Senate.

It’s been clear for some time that our campaign’s momentum is incredible. **We went from being the underdog to becoming the Democratic Nominee.**

There’s a long way to go between now and November though – **and Bob Menendez officially running as an Independent, making this a three-way race.** We need to make sure that we sustain and keep growing our momentum to unify our party and build a broad coalition of support for keeping this seat blue in November.

The only way we’ll win is through grassroots power and investments today in things like voter outreach, and that’s why I’m asking you to help us hit our $100,000 Blue Jersey goal by the end of the week.

🏳️🌈 **_Happy Pride Month:_ The DLCC stands united with the LGBTQ+ community **
As the official arm of the Democratic Party with the sole mission of building Democratic power in state legislatures, the DLCC is on the frontlines of protecting LGBTQ+ rights and freedoms in the states. We are proud to do our part to defend and amplify the voices of the LGBTQ+ community while making sure the GOP’s hateful attacks don’t slip under the radar.
* * *
🌈 **_Numbers to be proud of:_ Representation matters **
💙 There are **at least 222** openly LGBTQ+ state legislators currently serving in legislatures across the country – that’s a 23% increase in openly LGBTQ+ state legislators from 2022!
💛 **47 states** now have at least one openly LGBTQ+ state legislator
❤️ **Every state** with Democratic legislative majorities explicitly prohibits discrimination on the basis of gender identity or sexual orientation when it comes to employment, housing, and public accommodations.
🚨 **_Numbers you need to know:_ Republicans are on the attack **
🟦 **Over 500** anti-LGBTQ+ bills have been introduced in nearly 40 states around the country this year – attacking this community has become a mainstay priority for the GOP
🟪 **24 states** , all with GOP majorities, have no anti-discrimination state law protections for gender identity and sexual orientation when it comes to housing, employment, and public accommodations.
🟫 **25 states** have laws or regulations banning gender-affirming care for minors.

Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**June 9, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Hi Readers,
In Colorado's intense election cycle, the spotlight on campaign financing underscores a critical battleground for the Republican Party, particularly in key [House and Senate races](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). The fiscal strategies at play are shaping the future of conservative politics in the state, with the Republican primaries drawing significant financial and strategic interest.
One of the most heated contests is the Republican primary in [Colorado's 5th Congressional District](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), where over $1 million has been invested by conservative PACs. This substantial expenditure isn't just about winning in November; it's about defining the GOP's direction. The primary features Dave Williams, the Colorado GOP Chairman backed by Donald Trump, and Jeff Crank, a conservative commentator supported by House Speaker Mike Johnson.
Additionally, in House District 20, an [open seat in north El Paso County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), Republican candidates are also seeing considerable campaign activity. Jarvis Caldwell and Jason Lupo are vying for the seat, with Caldwell raising significant funds, partly through a substantial realtor contribution. This financial support is crucial as it likely decides the primary outcome in this predominantly Republican area.
[House District 21](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) is another focal point where incumbent Republican Mary Bradfield faces a primary challenge. Although campaign contributions are modest, the financial support signals vested interests in maintaining conservative representation.
This financial focus on Republican primaries illustrates the critical role of funding in sustaining and advancing conservative values within Colorado. It emphasizes the necessity for [robust campaign financing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to effectively contest and win in increasingly competitive political environments, ensuring that conservative governance continues to influence Colorado's legislative actions.
Have a great week ahead,
Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **STATE**
---
**[Video: The good initiatives on the ballot to protect Colorado's elections](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FREE STATE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) This November, Colorado voters will have the opportunity to fundamentally change election law in the state. From ranked-choice voting, to an all-candidate primary election, there will be initiatives to upend the electoral system.
**[Colorado is charting a rise in potential money laundering. Could stopping it slow the fentanyl trade?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) ** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Colorado money service businesses, such as check-cashing businesses and money forwarding services, filed a record number of reports last year of possible money laundering by people using their services, official data shows.
**[Coloradans have standing to sue over open meetings violations-- no matter where they live, court finds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO FREEDOM OF INFORMATION COALITION](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A Pagosa Springs attorney who has filed nearly 100 open-government lawsuits in the past several years has standing to sue the Elizabeth school board for alleged open meetings law violations even though he lives 300 miles away, the Colorado Court of Appeals ruled Thursday.

**[Primary Election'24: In 5th District, both Democratic and Republican races are opposed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) In Colorado's 5th District, both Republican and Democratic registered voters will be asked to weigh in on contested races for their party's nomination to the general election ballot.
**[State income tax credit for college tuition will cost Colorado $38M annually](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE CENTER SQUARE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A refundable state income tax credit, estimated at reducing Colorado's tax revenue by approximately $38 million, can now be used to pay for tuition and fees at Colorado's higher education institutions.
_**[READ MORE STATE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**NATIONAL**
**[Feds send millions of taxpayer dollars to the Taliban](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE CENTER STAGE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) After two decades at war with the Taliban, the U.S. government is now sending millions of taxpayer dollars to the terrorist group. The Taliban resumed power in Afghanistan immediately after the chaotic and deadly withdrawal of U.S. troops earlier in the Biden administration.
**[Lawyer, doctor, body man, bookkeeper: Joe Biden's personal aides get involved in his relatives' business dealings](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [POLITICO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) For years, Joe Biden shared a bookkeeper with his son, Hunter. He also shared a personal lawyer with his brother, Jim. And when Jim Biden wanted to know more about one of Hunter Biden's associates, he hired the former head of Joe Biden's Secret Service detail to investigate.

**[Treasury secretary blames labor unions for blocking return-to-work at IRS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The IRS is struggling to get its employees back to work in person at least 50% of the time, and Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen said the agency's labor union is the chief hurdle.

**[DOD failed to share rules on partisan politics with service members before election season](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [AIR FORCE TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The Pentagon failed to properly train and guide troops about off-limits political activities ahead of the 2024 presidential election season, a federal watchdog said.
**[READ MORE NATIONAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**LOCAL**
**[Elk stomping in Estes: Wildlife officials call for human caution after three incidents at gateway to RMN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) An elk stomped a human and caused injuries early Friday for the third time in two weeks in Estes Park, prompting warnings of unprecedented elk behavior during calving season at the Rocky Mountain National Park gateway.
**[$5.5M project in Arapahoe County aims to make travel safer for Colorado cyclists](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Construction crews in Arapahoe County are working to make a popular intersection more bike-friendly. Right now, crews are adding three new roundabouts around sections of Inverness West, Inverness East, and Inverness Boulevard by Dry Creek Road. The Inverness Drive Project is just one step in a very big project.
**[What's behind Wheat Ridge's 26% crime drop since 2021? Start with police staffing, mayor says.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WHEAT RIDGE NEIGHBORHOOD GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Wheat Ridge has seen a significant drop in crime rates, returning to levels last observed before the pandemic. The Wheat Ridge Police Department reports a 26% overall decrease in crime since 2021, marking a substantial improvement from the spike experienced during the pandemic.
**[Special district elections: RTD board will have elections to eight district seats](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Non-partisan elections of persons who sit on city councils, school districts, fire and water boards, and more, almost always are overshadowed in what is termed "down-ballot elections."
_**[READ MORE LOCAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**COMMENTARY**
**[Fuller: The many reasons you shouldn't be afraid to question election results](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE DAILY SIGNAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _It 's been said that the greatest trick the Devil ever pulled was convincing the world that he didn't exist. Most of us remember the national election of 2020: The COVID-19 pandemic, sudden changes to election procedures, mysterious mail-in ballots, allegedly hacked voting systems, and legions of lawyers filing scores of lawsuits._
**[Sey: Thanks to Title IX, I was a champion gymnast. Now it's been corrupted](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [SEY EVERYTHING SUBSTACK](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Fifty-two years ago this month, Title IX was enacted to prohibit sex discrimination in educational programs and activities at institutions that receive federal funding. And for all of its wide-reaching impacts, it is best known for mandating equality in sports between the sexes._
**[Archuleta: The ways in which a 30-day Pride month is counterproductive](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _A month-long celebration of Pride is counterproductive. I say this as a gay man who, at one time, was very active in the gay rights movement and organizing Pride Festivals. Over the past several years, I have rapidly been drawn to this conclusion. After 30 days of rainbows, the world is not a better place for the LGBT community, nor are we more unified with society. Likely, it is the opposite._
**[Stratford: What does human trafficking look like in Colorado?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _There are more than 49.6 million people in modern slavery today. What does that look like in Colorado? Human trafficking is the exploitation of another person involving force, fraud, or coercion for labor or sex. Human trafficking is a crime against a person, not a border. Anyone can become a victim, no matter a person 's background or identity, but the more vulnerable a person is the more likely they are to become a victim._ __
**[Zorn: Colorado's passenger rail romance vs. reality](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Have you noticed that the expansion of passenger rail is beginning to permeate agendas of state and local governments? The romance of big rail projects and access to other people 's money have always been hard for career politicians to resist. _

_**[READ MORE COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_

Fellow patriot,

Every 17 years, cicadas emerge from their long slumber, making a bunch of noise and creating a mess. This year, we’re not just talking about the insects. We’re talking about career politicians like Joe Biden and Sherrod Brown.

-> ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=10471132.4455.1.06f15f2bfcb5ab3874e77a7868965f3f )<-

Just like cicadas, these political hacks come out during election years, making loud promises while trying to cover up their previous failures with a ton of BS.

-> \*\*SEND THEM BACK INTO THE GROUND\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=10471132.4456.1.a23efc2a26e8718206237ab03c5514bf )<-

\*\*Their biggest failure: _the border._\*\*

And no matter how hard they try to get us to forget – _we won’t._ Biden reversed 94 of Pres. Trump's executive orders that had secured the southern border, deported illegals, and gave border patrol the resources they needed to do their job.

Now, after four long years and millions of illegals flooding into our country, he’s decided to sign a single, half-measure executive order that still allows a million illegals to come through the border. \*\*_And Sherrod Brown has been Joe Biden’s biggest cheerleader in the Senate this whole time._\*\*

-> \*\*SEND THEM BACK INTO THE GROUND\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=10471132.4457.1.9715c139390bd48a64835f3ce09cf60d )<-

Unlike cicadas, whose presence is a force of nature, the political cicadas can be voted out. We don’t have to endure their noise and chaos for another cycle. \*\*With your support, I will go to Washington to deliver for the American People and secure our southern border once and for all.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=10471132.4458.1.f9b1177e0d75b26d99b4462e4881c27a )

Don’t let the political cicadas win. \*\*Send them back to the ground where they belong.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=10471132.4459.1.27adcc8fef5170f4de7b21c881caa0a8 )

Bernie Moreno

->

\*\*Meet Bernie Moreno:\*\*

( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=10471132.4461.1.ad27cac7bfaf1bde79a060f3ada8de7f ) Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First.

Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has.

subject: I have a plan to secure the southern border...

body:
It is because I understand the life-and-death nature of securing the border that I am making the following three-part pledge regarding the border... | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/rickbecker2024/campaignannouncement-17380036?e=d842fb25cc)
---
|

[](https://rickbecker2024.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=e7826dd14d&e=d842fb25cc)
| Peter,

Throughout this Congressional race, each candidate has discussed the need for a secure southern border. Sadly, I feel none of the other candidates understand the urgency and severity of the situation. It is because I understand the life-and-death nature of securing the border that I am making the following three-part pledge regarding the border:

**1.) I will shut down the federal government if the border is not secured.** You read that right. I will not vote to fund government operations unless funding for border security is included. No border funding, no government funding, it’s that simple.

**2.) I will not take a salary until the Trump border policies are reinstated.** Do you want to see your representative work their butt off for something? Tie their salary to that thing. That’s what I’m committing to you that I’ll do. We can re-secure the border with President Trump’s border policies and until that happens, I’ll be donating my salary.

**3.) I will not be voting for Speaker Mike Johnson.** Speaker Johnson promised many times not to fund the war in Ukraine until we passed border security measures. He then caved, sending $100 billion dollars to fund foreign wars while the invasion continues to happen right here at home. In Washington, people are policy, and I will not vote for the open-border Speaker Johnson.
---
[](https://rickbecker2024.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=fa53af60ed&e=d842fb25cc)
| Our nation’s security and sovereignty depend on a secure southern border. We cannot afford to have leaders who merely talk about border security without taking decisive action.

My three-part pledge is a testament to my unwavering commitment to protecting our border and ensuring the safety of American families. It’s time for bold leadership and real solutions, not empty promises. Together, we can restore the security and integrity of our great nation. Let's make sure our voices are heard and our border is secured.

Join me in this fight for America’s future. Get out and vote tomorrow!
LET’S WIN!
---

On May 6 Hamas said it [accepted a ceasefire proposal that included release of all hostages](https://substack.com/redirect/71ee1011-1993-4551-8275-62844588550c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Israel rejected it. On May 31 [President Biden announced an Israeli approved deal of a complete ceasefire](https://substack.com/redirect/eeb097be-5212-473c-b5fa-a32883a425f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from both sides and a release of all hostages. On June 7 Israel [publicly rejected a UN resolution that was in support of Israel's own deal](https://substack.com/redirect/164c9804-a2fe-449d-b323-4e3ed594d01d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And on June 8, Israel bombed the Nuseirat refugee camp, [killing 274 Palestinians and injuring 400 more](https://substack.com/redirect/5c86a863-3a4c-4010-99b9-4bcf8e15205c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). All done to secure four hostages, with celebration and commendation from [US Secretary of State Blinken](https://substack.com/redirect/ebde1465-fb58-4d49-a32e-9b76c2b11563?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and other world leaders, [yet no mention whatsoever of the hundreds of Palestinians killed](https://substack.com/redirect/2f74eebc-c642-499f-bdc4-f116e2ba7d58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
**So here 's my simple question no one seems to want to answer:** How is anyone celebrating four hostages for 274 killed Palestinians, when the deal on the table was ALL hostages for zero killed?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/164c9804-a2fe-449d-b323-4e3ed594d01d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I asked this question on social media, and while not a single person bothered to actually answer, plenty of people surprisingly responded that the goal is not release of hostages, but defeating Hamas. This is news to me because all we've heard these past 8 months is "_the war will end when Hamas releases the hostages._ "
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..o1jydoAmToEX7jLIuBy7vaqkMKzj_PqH-ECoUyc5H08?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145459381)
But suddenly the goal posts shift, and the real answer is defeating Hamas, as social media reminded me, over, and over, and over again. For example, here's just a snapshot of response I received to my above question:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/04e7f8f6-0719-4622-a58e-8d71ce417a76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/339d8379-8071-4453-b089-24a3178bb7e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/163d7832-23c8-4742-bb05-1fb13a2c3c32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
If the _real_ answer is not securing hostages, but defeating Hamas permanently, then I'd love someone to explain two things.
First, why did [Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu happily fund Hamas](https://substack.com/redirect/31dd571b-da43-4dad-b340-363336c79ba2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for years, with the express goal of undermining peace and stability for Palestine (and ostensibly Israel too), and why has there been no accountability for his deliberate actions to empower and strengthen Hamas against Israel? As the Times of Israel reports:
> Israeli policy was to treat the Palestinian Authority as a burden and Hamas as an asset. Far-right MK Bezalel Smotrich, now the finance minister in the hardline government and leader of the Religious Zionism party, said so himself in 2015.
> According to various reports, Netanyahu made a similar point at a Likud faction meeting in early 2019, when he was quoted as saying that those who oppose a Palestinian state should support the transfer of funds to Gaza, because maintaining the separation between the Palestinian Authority in the West Bank and Hamas in Gaza would prevent the establishment of a Palestinian state.
And given that Netanyahu openly funded and propped up Hamas, it's fascinating hypocrisy to see the United States invite him [to address a joint session of Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/e6f50b72-0e3e-44a6-bdd2-7b6ba843aa93?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..o1jydoAmToEX7jLIuBy7vaqkMKzj_PqH-ECoUyc5H08?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145459381)
Second, if the _" real" _goal is defeating Hamas, can we drop the myth that it was ever about hostages? These aren't my words, but the words of the former spokesperson for the families of hostages, Haim Rubinstein. In an interview given to The Times of Israel, Rubinstein lamented on how the Israeli government "absolutely ignored" them, and [after an October 26 meeting with Netanyahu he felt particularly disappointed](https://substack.com/redirect/bc803125-1302-4f74-af1b-5333dbca65ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because the return of hostages was not the Israeli government's priority:
> We left the meeting very disappointed because Netanyahu talked about dismantling Hamas as the goal of the war. He didn't promise anything regarding the demand to return the hostages. He merely said a military operation in Gaza was needed to serve as leverage for the hostages' release. We later found out that Hamas had offered on October 9 or 10 to release all the civilian hostages in exchange for the IDF not entering the Strip, _but the government rejected the offer_.
Joining this chorus demonstrating that the Israeli government has never truly cared about hostages is former hostage Louis Har, who said in an interview to Haaretz:
> Our greatest fear was the IDF's planes and the concern that they would bomb the building we were in. I was asoldier myself once. But the feeling that it could be our own bombs, our own planes -- that this is what would kill us --that's very scary and very anxiety-inducing.
So to recap: The very man responsible for funding and propping up Hamas, now used a propped up Hamas as the excuse to prioritize war over release of hostages. And now, that same man who agreed with President Biden to terms of a complete ceasefire and release of all hostages, now claims it wasn't his deal to begin with and justifies killing 274 Palestinians to secure four hostages. And that's precisely how his supporters then responded to my simple question above. For example:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c0773ea9-f4f1-4ecc-b664-850e21d3bf3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/40cc2b0a-8c64-493e-867d-febf6ef1ade8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..o1jydoAmToEX7jLIuBy7vaqkMKzj_PqH-ECoUyc5H08?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145459381)
Apparently, and according to the current goal shifting narrative, President Biden is now in cahoots with Hamas against Israel. So to be explicitly clear, Israel approved the deal President Biden cited. As NPR [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/eeb097be-5212-473c-b5fa-a32883a425f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> [President Biden] then _laid out the three phases of Israel 's proposal_.
> The first phase is six weeks: a full and complete cease-fire and withdrawal of Israeli forces from all populated areas of Gaza, as well as the release of a number of hostages -- including American hostages -- in exchange for the release of "hundreds" of Palestinian prisoners.
And yet the alleged goal post shifted from release the hostages, to forget the hostages and defeat Hamas instead, to forget any deal at all because it wasn't Israel's deal in the first place. At this rate, who knows what the goal will be tomorrow, but one thing is for sure--Netanyahu has made clear he has no intention of stopping his indiscriminate bombing of Gaza. This much should be obvious to anyone. Maya Angelou once said, "When people show you who they are, believe them the first time."
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=145459381&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ1NDU5MzgxLCJpYXQiOjE3MTgwMjQ4MTcsImV4cCI6MTcyMDYxNjgxNywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.39qRKLrxEBQl0n6HNlKMKvncyrq4_W1sv8YyLFE-CYE)
Which brings me back to the answer to my simple question that no one pro war seems to want to admit. That no, four hostages for the price of 274 killed Palestinians and ongoing bloodshed is _not_ better than _all_ hostages for zero Palestinians and a complete ceasefire. Knowing this, the United States has a clear choice: It can either finally uphold international rules based order and stop funding war crimes, or be remembered by history as complicit.
And for the rest of us, if we are truly committed to upholding justice above all else, we must be willing and courageous enough to call out these injustices loudly and clearly.

First off, yes I'm still running for U.S. Congress for Utah's 2nd District.
If you're from Utah and registered with a party, you likely received a primary ballot in the mail recently. Some of you may have noticed (and some asked) where my name was so they could vote for me. Well, even though I'm a registered Republican, I'm not running as a Republican. I'm running as unaffiliated.
Running as unaffiliated means I'm not running as a Republican so I'm not on the Republican primary ballot.
I gathered enough signatures to qualify to be on the ballot in November so that is when you'll vote for me (hopefully!). My name will be on the ballot.
Also, where have I been?
Without getting into too many details, life happened.
Now back to the campaign trail.
I've completed my campaign site and I would love for you to visit [https://www.tylermurset.com](https://substack.com/redirect/768c6117-0d18-43a4-9e92-dc493a071c9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Now taking donations there!
I've also completed the design of my signs. I would love it if you placed one of my signs in your yard or business. Go here to request a sign or get involved in another way [https://www.tylermurset.com/get-involved](https://substack.com/redirect/0537b38e-3f8d-43d2-93fa-b93adffe88bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

See you soon!

Questions answered... | | | Jun 10 | | | | | | | | | | | | First off, yes I'm still running for U.S. Congress for Utah's 2nd District. If you're from Utah and registered with a party, you likely received a primary ballot in the mail recently. Some of you may have noticed (and some asked) where my name was so they could vote for me. Well, even though I'm a registered Republican, I'm not running as a Republican. I'm running as unaffiliated. Running as unaffiliated means I'm not running as a Republican so I'm not on the Republican primary ballot. I gathered enough signatures to qualify to be on the ballot in November so that is when you'll vote for me (hopefully!). My name will be on the ballot. Also, where have I been? Without getting into too many details, life happened. Now back to the campaign trail. I've completed my campaign site and I would love for you to visit Now taking donations there! I've also completed the design of my signs. I would love it if you placed one of my signs in your yard or business. ---

This project provides objective and scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and well-being. #
**Fox News: Youngkin calls out Pentagon 's plan to gift China millions with rooftop solar panels**

**ICYMI:** Governor Glenn Youngkin is continuing his efforts to protect Virginians and Americans from the Chinese Communist Party (CCP).

As [Fox News reports](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=dd24adb35eb9291d4ca567682a4ef7f7f40fd68cae11548ccac9e14bf90b41190f01b15bc1671df6823b58242b5cf8104d9d565242136a5063620accfa974509 "Fox News reports"), "Virginia Gov. Glenn Youngkin penned a letter to Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin to question the wisdom of the Pentagon's plan to use $104 million in taxpayer funds to add solar panels to the rooftop of the Pentagon. The Virginia Republican told Austin that he has 'serious concerns' about the plan to secure solar panels to the rooftop of the Pentagon and other military installations, most notably that there has been no 'stated requirement that such panels be made in America using American technology.'"

Youngkin wrote in the letter that "this decision has significant implications for U.S. national security and brings into question whether American taxpayer dollars will be used to purchase solar equipment from the Chinese Communist Party (CCP), our greatest economic and geopolitical rival."

Youngkin has been a leader among America's governors in taking decisive action against potential threats from the CCP.

Last year, Youngkin halted a Chinese battery company from coming to Virginia, [citing concerns](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=dd24adb35eb9291d70edb101622f687d6d2931e437ac0223b2348f66af8ecd3f6ffc3463785957d405cae92b9587b4e856d53696befaeea14135b2ffff050d62 "citing concerns") it would serve as a "Trojan horse" for the CCP.

Youngkin's decision was validated after Congress banned the Pentagon from purchasing batteries from that very same company.

As [Bloomberg reported](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=dd24adb35eb9291d603c6c123eec284005a5d6200e7aabcbacaf75d5b5da16b85689599ad80f3836603170af3446d8d5fa0c772790d9dac5746b892a65777c30 "Bloomberg reported"), "US lawmakers have banned the Defense Department from buying batteries produced by China's biggest manufacturers, furthering efforts in Washington to decouple the Pentagon's supply chain from its geopolitical rival. The rule implemented as part of the latest National Defense Authorization Act that passed on Dec. 22 will prevent procuring batteries from Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Ltd."

In his latest letter to the Biden Administration, Youngkin expressed strong concerns over the potential national security risks of adding solar panels to the rooftop of the Pentagon and urged the administration to ensure that these solar panels are manufactured in the United States with American-made material.

"I seriously question the prioritization of this investment and the national security implications of this potential procurement," Youngkin said. "If this proceeds, I strongly urge you to ensure any hardware installed on the roof of the Pentagon is manufactured in the United States and the component materials are domestically sourced."
**IN CASE YOU MISSED IT**
[FOX NEWS: Youngkin calls out Pentagon's plan to gift China millions with rooftop solar panels](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=dd24adb35eb9291d68493803f7b965c6e3eff1cdf7360def240a12262376cd2db96fe97bb558d8f9a2b7ca58843e35eb6d49f1723629b3aeceee51a527544d9d "FOX NEWS: Youngkin calls out Pentagon’s plan to gift China millions with rooftop solar panels")
Exclusive: Virginia Gov. Glenn Youngkin penned a letter to Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin to question the wisdom of the Pentagon's plan to use $104 million in taxpayer funds to add solar panels to the rooftop of the Pentagon.

The Virginia Republican told Austin that he has "serious concerns" about the plan to secure solar panels to the rooftop of the Pentagon and other military installations, most notably that there has been no "stated requirement that such panels be made in America using American technology."

"This decision has significant implications for U.S. national security and brings into question whether American taxpayer dollars will be used to purchase solar equipment from the Chinese Communist Party (CCP), our greatest economic and geopolitical rival," reads the letter, which was reviewed by Fox News Digital.

The letter comes after a January Defense Department announcement about the plan, which it said was part of the Biden administration's effort to promote clean energy and "reestablish the federal government as a sustainability leader."

The Pentagon is just one of 31 government sites that are slated to receive the $104 million in Energy Department grants, according a PBS report from January, with projects also taking place at the U.S. Army Garrison in Wiesbaden, Germany, and other locations.

But Youngkin voiced multiple concerns about the plan, noting that "companies highly influenced or controlled by the CCP dominate the global solar supply chain," making it vital that the Defense Department "require that military procurements for solar panels must come from verified domestic manufacturers with trusted supply chains."

The governor also highlighted other issues in addition to the national security implications, noting that Chinese solar panels have a higher carbon footprint than U.S. producers and often rely on forced labor to build them.

"I seriously question the prioritization of this investment and the national security implications of this potential procurement," Youngkin concluded. "If this proceeds, I strongly urge you to ensure any hardware installed on the roof of the Pentagon is manufactured in the United States and the component materials are domestically sourced."

The Pentagon did not immediately respond to a Fox News Digital request for comment.

subject: Cameron Hamilton's campaign for Congress
body:
Good morning Mr. Willis,
I am reaching out this morning because you recently signed up on Cameron Hamilton's website. We first wanted to thank you for your interest in supporting the campaign. How would you like to help?

Some ways to help get Cameron across the line is by:

* Distributing literature within your networks
* Reaching out to voters using i360o call
* Attending upcoming events

As we approach voting day for the Republican primaries on June 18th, we are asking supporters if they would be willing to help out by distributing literature at their local polling stations on voting day. If this is something you are willing and able to help out with, please let me know.

We hope you have a good day, and once again thank you for your help and support.

clean_body: GOAL: 10,000 signatures to Congress | | | | | ---|---|--- | Hi, Last month, we told you how the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) recently finalized nine historic standards, achieving monumental progress on climate and clean air. None of this progress would have been possible without your continued advocacy. But, big polluters and their cronies—including Edison Electric Institute, the group that lobbies on behalf of utility companies across the country—are working relentlessly to undo all of it. The Republican-led House is following suit with Big-Oil-backed efforts to attack the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) and take away the biggest climate investments in history. | | Under the bold leadership of the Biden administration, EPA, and every member of Congress who led the fight to pass the IRA, the U.S. is doing more than ever before to tackle the climate crisis. EPA's regulatory analysis projects that the new limits on carbon pollution from power plants, together with the IRA, will lead to a 75 percent reduction in carbon pollution below 2005 levels by 2035. body:

**BE SURE TO HAVE YOUR FAMILY & FRIENDS "JOIN US":**

---
| | | **
CONCERNED ABOUT HIGH
PROPERTY TAXES?
YOUR ASSESSMENT
GONE WILD?
HERE'S A WAY TO FIGHT!**

---
|
We want to introduce you to a group that's fighting Ohio's unfair & onerous taxing system, specifically property taxes. [**Lobbyists for Citizens** ](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=982aaceea9&e=5c740fa3e2)is working hard to educate voters, pressure legislators, and activate Ohio citizens to help fight excessive Ohio taxes at all levels of government. They are looking for more volunteers to help them in their battle against entrenched interests, career politicians, and a biased legacy corporate Ohio media.

[**Lobbyists for Citizens**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=8ae7d6da71&e=5c740fa3e2) is an apolitical, grassroots citizens’ group, registered with the State of Ohio as a 501 (C) (4) Domestic Non-Profit Corporation.

Please go to the **Lobbyists for Citizens** website & register to join their email list by clicking [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=dbc5aead37&e=5c740fa3e2) or on the image below. Share this message with friends & family. As well, to gain an appreciation for their thinking around Ohio's vexing property tax system, read this article titled: "[**What is the Role of Government? Are Property Taxes Immoral?**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=261c5b9721&e=5c740fa3e2)"

THANK YOU!

|

**ALERT: UPCOMING EVENTS
WE'VE BEEN ASKED
TO PROMOTE!**

---
|
_Here are 3 events we've been asked by their organizers to promote. Please take a look and consider attending!_

**MARIETTA AREA, MONDAY JUNE 10TH (TOMORROW!)
ORGANIZATIONAL MEETING
TRUMP PARADE, RALLY, AND PATRIOTISM EVENT!**

Tomorrow evening (Monday) June 10th at 7:00 PM at Freedom Gate Church, Marietta, there will be an organizational meeting for a July 6th "**Stand With President Trump Rally, Parade, and Show Your Pride** " event. The organizers tell us they need many people to volunteer for this event. Any questions, please call 740-516-6068. More contact information can be found on the image below, by clicking [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=142520742c&e=5c740fa3e2), or by clicking on the image below.

THANK YOU!

|

**COLUMBUS, OHIO STATEHOUSE, TUESDAY JUNE 11TH
CONVENTION OF STATES ACTION (COS) OHIO ADVOCACY DAY**

>From Ed Mulholland:

"Stand up and be Counted!

Tuesday, June 11th, Ohioans are gathering at the Statehouse to advocate for HJR3, the resolution calling for an Article V Convention of States. Join on the 11th to meet your legislators and let them know you support HJR3. The time has come for the states to call a convention and get our federal government back under control.

The readers of this email are not the type to sit around and complain. You are reading this because you care about America and you are working to fix our broken system. A [**Convention of States**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=4aac6295b9&e=5c740fa3e2) is one way we can make lasting change; reeling in our out-of-control federal government, applying some fiscal discipline, and imposing term limits to remove the self-appointed royalty in congress and the [Deep State] swamp.

We will gather at 9 AM on the ground level of the Statehouse. Just head to the "Map Room". We’ll hear from our Sponsors, Representatives McClain and Willis. We will also hear from Dr. Micheal Farris. Dr. Farris will be in town to support our efforts. He is a nationally known constitutional attorney who helped to overturn Roe v. Wade.

Learn more at: [**conventionofstates.com**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=897c6d5a64&e=5c740fa3e2)

For details about COS Advocacy Day at the Ohio Statehouse email: [**ed.mulholland@cosaction.com**](mailto:ed.mulholland@cosaction.com)"

THANK YOU!

---

**DEFEND & PROTECT OUR CHILDREN'S FUTURE!**
**AMERICA’S FUTURE - GET IN THE FIGHT!
OHIO SUMMIT & TRAINING
JUNE 14 & 15, PORTAGE COUNTY CHAPEL, RAVENNA**

Watch, listen, and learn from "America’s Future - Project Defend & Protect Our Children" trainers & advisors about the importance of getting involved and attending their GET IN THE FIGHT campaigns to combat child exploitation & trafficking in America. Register for the GET IN THE FIGHT Ohio State Summit and Training on June 14 & 15 at Portage Community Chapel in Ravenna: [**https://www.americasfuture.net/get-in-the-fight-ohio/**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=ad26ca4999&e=5c740fa3e2)

To view a video about this effort & event click [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=1f62060aa3&e=5c740fa3e2) or on the image below.

THANK YOU!

| [ ](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=6b976081d3&e=5c740fa3e2)
---
| |
**KEEP AMERICA FOR AMERICANS!
CHINA'S SILENT WAR ON AMERICA!
WEEK 3 • LESSON 3**

---
|
In May we sent out a one-time special message about a new initiative called "[**America for Americans**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=58933160ee&e=5c740fa3e2)" designed to wake up more Ohioans to the threat China poses to our communities, state, and nation. If you haven't seen that message, you can access a copy of it on the web [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=e4757732f1&e=5c740fa3e2).

Part of this initiative is an Ohio-developed, 10-week "course" titled “**China’s Silent War on America** ”. A lesson will be released every week for 10 weeks. To remind you, we'll highlight new lessons in this email. Last week we highlighted [**Lesson 2**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=c164e97339&e=5c740fa3e2). This week, we're highlighting [**Lesson 3**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=d5a38d8ed1&e=5c740fa3e2): **China’s United Front Work Spreads the Communist Ideology Around the Globe[.](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=a02e1e1ca6&e=5c740fa3e2)**

[**America for Americans**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=1f19922429&e=5c740fa3e2) will provide a short lesson, one a week for ten weeks, to educate us on the many strategies China is using to undermine America’s power at home and abroad, while enriching its own homeland. The reader will also be guided towards action items to help reduce China’s influence in the state of Ohio.

Click [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=3cf9e23df4&e=5c740fa3e2) or on the image below to access **Lesson 3** of “**China’s Silent War on America** ” called **"China’s United Front Work Spreads the Communist Ideology Around the Globe".**

_Next week's lesson, Lesson 4, will be the first of 5 lessons providing examples of China’s United Front's work in America and show how each of these initiatives undermines America’s national security._

THANK YOU!

name: bloated ankles
subject: What IS lymphedema?!
body:
Your lymphatic system acts as a one-way detox channel for your body...
It filters and carries cellular waste and harmful bacteria into your bloodstream for your liver & kidneys to process and flush out...
It also plays an important part in delivering essential nutrients all the way from your brain to the bottoms of your feet.
Over time, these lymphatic channels can break down, age, and congest - rendering them USELESS... _often resulting in swollen tissue around your legs, ankles, and feet._
If you've noticed **your ankles are a little puffier... your shoes feel tighter... or your socks are leaving a red ring around your ankles...**
You may find relief when you feed your body UNIQUE FATTY ACIDS recently found to support healthy lymphatic function... help to remove clogs... and increase lymphatic flow.

body:

_"Chuck Morse has been a champion for securing educational choice for New Hampshire families. Without his leadership, our students would not have the opportunities they have today," stated Ruth Ward._

**In Liberty, ** **Chuck Morse **

Each offers a wide range of products and services, from banking and investment products to financial advisors and financial planning services.

However, there are some important differences, from fees to financial services to research resources, each of which could impact your customer experience. Ready to kickstart your retirement? Working with a financial advisor can be a crucial part of any healthy retirement plan. But with thousands of options available, knowing where to start can seem daunting. All advisors on the platform are rigorously screened through a proprietary due diligence process and legally bound to work in your best interest.

While your advisor matches may not necessarily be associated with the above institutions, research suggests people who work with a financial advisor:
* feel more at ease about their finances
* could end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.1

It's never too late to plan to work toward a comfortable retirement.

subject: River's Community Currents
body:
See where we’ve been these past two weeks | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/riverforcolorado/rivers-community-currents-8262066?e=3818d77efc)
---
| |
---
| |
#### 06/10/2024
Dear family and supporters, Check your mailbox! Ballots have been sent out and the voting has begun. Remember to vote early and vote down the Democratic ballot!

Are you an unaffiliated voter? Unaffiliated voters can and should vote too - making the majority of the voting population, it all comes down to you! But remember you can only vote on one ticket. Turn in only one ballot, or your vote will not count.

For those in my district who need postage, reply to this email and we'll get a volunteer to drop a stamp off to you. But keep in mind too, that you can turn in your ballot without postage to any ballot drop box for free. You can also turn it into your mailbox without a stamp ( however El Paso County will incur that cost to cover the services done by USPS).
In the meantime, our campaign has been out in the community getting the word out!
It's Pride Month, and our campaign has been building momentum, and getting our voices heard. The LGBTQ+ community has been threatened in Colorado Springs. Dave Williams has even been promoting hate crimes against them - but we are a district of strength and resilience. This month I hope to amplify our voices and represent that resilience.

See where we’ve been this past week.

Kicking off Pride Month by supporting our LGBTQ+ youth.

| Pikes Peak Pride Parade and Pride Festival
The Pikes Peak Pride Festival grows in size every year - and during this two-day festival, we reached out to countless voters, building excitement for the campaign and bringing along numerous new volunteers.

| | | Celebrating Recent Endorsements This week Shay Dabney has endorsed us. Shay was a 2023 Candidate for the D11 School Board election.

| **More to Come** Find me this week at the Summer Market Season Kickoff! Or better yet, come out and support us this Sunday! We will be at the Hero's Hollow in Manitou Springs. A fundraising silent art auction, snacks, and drinks! A bar will be open and alcoholic beverages will be available for purchase - support our local small businesses in the process.
---
|
---
|
---
|
#### Yard signs are here!

If you've seen our signs around town, you're not alone. We have a few more left. Support the campaign and get yours now!
---
|
---
---
| [Order yours today](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=e2b9ae2b4e&e=3818d77efc "Order yours today")
---
|
---
| Final Thoughts of the Week It's June - and as I am sure many of you know, this is the most difficult time of the election to fundraise. It also happens to be one of the more costly months.

We need to head into the general election with a strong cash-on-hand. Your donation today will help us accomplish this.

Early donations help us organize before we head into the general. Donations today will create the momentum we need to gain. The FEC filing deadline is just 5 days after the primaries are completed. 5 days is simply not enough to get the showing we will need against the Republican nominee.

Delaying donations will weaken the competitive edge we need against the Republicans. We have a strong chance of winning, and early donations are crucial for building a robust and competitive campaign from the outset. Not the mention the last Act Blue check to be cut for us before the FEC filing deadline will be on June 24th - we will then have to wait until July to have an actual increase in our cash on hand.

Donations made**now** will go the longest way!

Thank you for your support. Sincerely, River Gassen - Democratic Candidate for Colorado’s 5th Congressional District

| Dear Fellow Patriot,

It saddens me to see that our education system has been taken over by radicals who push insane political ideologies like CRT, DEI, transgenderism and more on our poor children.

To me, it's common sense that school curriculum needs to be focused on the priority of teaching kids basic subjects such as reading, math, and civics.

How did that basic knowledge seem to get conveniently lost over the years?

You and I know that when it comes to a child's education and health, as well as their moral and religious upbringing, parents are primarily responsible.

That's why I believe parents have the right to steer their children's education, especially when it comes to sensitive subjects and that schools should resist the incorporation of non-academic subjects that fall within the family's purview.

Gov. Jim Justice is a conservative leader, successful businessman, high school basketball coach, and devoted family man. Before being elected, Gov. Justice led over 100 companies, creating thousands of jobs.

Gov. Justice has delivered on his promise of diversifying West Virginia's economy. He enacted the largest personal income tax cut in state history. He protects traditional values and has been recognized as a pro-life champion, signing more pro-life legislation into law than any governor in state history. As an avid outdoorsman, he vigorously defends the Second Amendment. He is passionate about mentoring young people and serves as the head coach of his local high school basketball team.

Gov. Justice and his wife, First Lady Cathy Justice, have been best friends since high school. They recently celebrated their 46th wedding anniversary. The Governor and the First Lady have two adult children and spend time spoiling four grandchildren. In addition, they have three dogs: Lucy and Ellie, Boston Terriers, and their famous Babydog, an English Bulldog.

body:
"All public service is a trust, given in faith and accepted in honor.”
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=3212%2E552475%2EPY1gNN)
Can I tell you a story, Peter?
[**Before I get into it, I need to ask: Can you pitch in $5 or more to my re-election campaign today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240610-1?recurring=1&refcode=em20240610-1&refcode2=3212_552475_PY1gNN&akid=3212%2E552475%2EPY1gNN)
You may not know this about me, but I began my career in public service as Pennsylvania’s Auditor General.
Every day, before I walked through the front door of the Finance Building in Harrisburg, I’d take a moment to read the inscription above:
**"All public service is a trust, given in faith and accepted in honor.”**
These are words I live by to this day.
As your Senator, I am reminded daily that you have trusted me to fight for what’s right. I work to earn that trust by standing up for you and your families: against Republican attacks on Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid; against tax cuts for the ultra-rich; against economic adversaries like China that threaten our jobs with unfair trade practices; and against big health care companies raising costs for the middle class.
Peter, my record as Senator makes it clear who I’m fighting for in Washington. My Republican opponent, on the other hand, has a decades-long record of selling out working people and shipping jobs overseas — to enrich himself and his Wall Street friends. That’s why the stakes are too high to sit out this election.
I am once again asking for the honor of your trust.
My re-election fight this year promises to be among the country’s most expensive and competitive Senate races. I will fight to defend this seat and our Democratic majority, but I need you on my side.

# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2781%2E35263%2EjCgaZG)
[](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-jun24.Hijekx&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240610_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=2781%2E35263%2EjCgaZG) I’m used to being written off, Peter. When I first ran for Congress in Wisconsin in 1997, no one thought I could win — especially when an extremely popular challenger jumped into the race. I remember huddling with one of my staffers at the time, and she said, “Well Tammy, maybe you want to rethink what you’re doing because it’s going to be tough.” I looked her right in the eye and asked, “Do you think I should wait my turn?” The next thing I said was this: I believe that women have to run — especially when it’s hard — and not wait our turn. We can’t wait until we get a tap on our shoulder or we’ll never get anywhere. I ended up winning that race and became the very first woman elected to the House of Representatives from Wisconsin. And it wouldn’t be the last time our team would make history. When I ran for U.S. Senate in 2012, an incredible team of grassroots supporters like you fought alongside me — even as some people wrote us off. You helped me become the first woman elected to the chamber from our state and the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history. In 2018, despite being a top target for national Republicans and enduring over a year of attacks, you stood with me again, and we won. Time and again, grassroots supporters like you have defied the odds. The battle to protect my seat this year will be no different. With my Republican opponent, Eric Hovde, prepared to spend up to $20 million of his own fortune to buy this seat and polls showing this race in a dead heat, this will be my toughest election yet. A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we...
* Consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America.
* Explore how the ideology of "woke capitalism" is infiltrating large corporations.

| | | In a moment, I’ll tell you why I’m running for Congress in Virginia’s battleground 7th District. _
_ _But if you’re ready to pitch in before the June 18 primary,[donate now to help us get out the vote!](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvhsqD6hnNNbCP7JMDskKO3cUi1ULK_L6L6bd19-LO1t8-DbTu1afrSyRRK_yaMHq1KU05uwgFmeHW3wloUQsJpHRvc8T60W9MkyqhwanUSxb8BKT23ea7ZxeG_kCZj3xoMBjWdMxfOWVt_fF8jUhkx2qYFg_UPSmBpU4nMHFyE265EWtI3z6mf_j5SanWSHKdHPc-7M-uR7yeBh9V1-kdu-XDf1b_CE3V8e8RXpNZOQwjhrsig9oM4I1l5BEh_iDsmC_YvEgpoB65CIzkk4xuqtjKy8Sxs9YTh_UtYsFAjPAr82hN7ibk9DKqO20YWWmxGyYJelGps9O0E1RI7Xn3I/473/7PO_RAhBSKCCPwm3KpL0Bw/h0/h001.L871nQdAQU0_1jiPvnSVuXjo3DcWtewU6uN8H1FLw0s)_
When I first immigrated to America as a single mom, I worked three minimum wage jobs at the same time - Wendy’s at daytime, CVS at nights, and retail on weekends.
We went from sleeping on couches to a one-bedroom apartment as I finished my education, becoming a social worker and union member.
**After Trump came to power, I ran for office to fight back, flipping a red seat in the Virginia House of Delegates and becoming the first immigrant Latina elected in its 400-year history.** [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvhsqD6hnNNbCP7JMDskKO3cUi1ULK_L6L6bd19-LO1t8-DbTu1afrSyRRK_yaMHq1KU05uwgFmeHW3wloUQsJpHNmf6YvdBk_qhBQ3gBWWW14xIpy-1s-CIac--SUfm5RqNeIZuHo4PyRwBjg5nRgPLOa2HbT7z438sTzgFSz92MX7erRIS-l8h3Ip4k3-cm6PT_KKa4TVuChKFN_D-MZjYYajLHGfLqbB1IEyFTeQNToPKrJ2_fVbQnBM3FQTWwAQIAq-QTEXrsCYPiVRG_JvCkuqdDVA1r5Y9tu8r56RVlCtQEFhbI79lSEyKRSrf8NBTicvregYuMiUnWkhVC4n/473/7PO_RAhBSKCCPwm3KpL0Bw/h1/h001.6RAgKJHZFLGYRY9nwBOu_EF4kGq0XCDlCrV0cOQ0JZQ) Whenever the voting buttons at my desk lit up, I remembered how my family achieved the American dream. That’s why I voted to deliver historic increases in the minimum wage, defend public education from right-wing attacks, and repeal Virginia’s Jim Crow-era ban on collective bargaining for teachers and other public sector workers. **I’m running for Congress because I still believe in world-class public education, safe workplaces with fair wages, and a dignified retirement.** ****Republicans in Congress want to ban books and cut school funding. They attack unions and keep wages low. And they’re trying to privatize Medicare and Social Security. **Together, we can erase the narrow 218-213 Republican majority in the House, defeat Trump in Virginia for a third time, and keep the American dream alive.** ******** **[Before the June 18 primary, donate to help our campaign get out the vote. It's Dan — Director of Organizing and Digital Engagement at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC! I have a question: What is it worth to you to elect bold climate champions, end the fossil fuel industry’s influence on our government, and ensure a livable, clean energy future for the generations to come? _**[$5? Maybe more?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86631014/478494679/2105508926?amount=5&refcode=ea.9f5c0452-4427-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.9f5c0452-4427-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjlmNWMwNDUyLTQ0MjctZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=R0FMkKnruWySuSAbghUG9svb6DOiwjp6CW_6uzoHMEg=)**_ I’ve long been inspired by people who use their resources and their platforms to affect change in a way I could never imagine. People like Jane, who have been protesting and demonstrating longer than I’ve been alive. People like Nalleli Cobo, who have chosen to respond to the deadly health impacts of fossil fuel pollution with years of dedicated advocacy for countless frontline communities whose health is under threat every day merely for existing in a certain location. I know I probably sound like a Mastercard credit card commercial when I say this, but there are truly some things money can’t buy, like the inspiration, motivation, and persistence of my climate heroes. But the unfortunate reality is that when it comes to winning elections, money talks. **[That’s why I’m asking you to contribute $5 to help the Jane Fonda Climate PAC close our $25,000 end-of-quarter fundraising gap between now and the end of June >>>](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86631016/478494681/2105508926?amount=5&refcode=ea.9f5c0452-4427-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.9f5c0452-4427-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjlmNWMwNDUyLTQ0MjctZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=R0FMkKnruWySuSAbghUG9svb6DOiwjp6CW_6uzoHMEg=)** Here’s why your support today is crucial: **$5** could be the difference between electing leaders who are ready to challenge the fossil fuel industry and those who continue to support harmful environmental policies. **$5** could be the difference between having the resources to implement a robust field program that mobilizes pro-climate voters in competitive districts, and missing our chance to connect with those voters. **$5** could be the difference between spreading the word about clean energy and climate justice, and letting Big Oil dominate the conversation. I know it may seem like a stretch to say any one of those things will actually be the deciding factor in any given race, but I’m really not exaggerating. This quarter alone, two of our endorsed climate champions won their races by shockingly small margins. Molly Cook is now headed towards her first full term as the first openly LGBTQ+ member of the Texas State Senate because she won by a margin of only 74 votes. And in Berkeley, Igor Tregub won his city council seat by less than 50 votes. With less than 5 months until Election Day, we have the opportunity now to come together and make sure that our climate champions have the resources they need to win in some very tough races. **[Are you with us? If so, please chip in $5 (or perhaps even more!) to help us meet our make-or-break goal on June 30th and continue our critical work. Your support at this moment is more powerful than you might realize.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86631018/478494683/2105508926?amount=5&refcode=ea.9f5c0452-4427-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.9f5c0452-4427-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjlmNWMwNDUyLTQ0MjctZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=R0FMkKnruWySuSAbghUG9svb6DOiwjp6CW_6uzoHMEg=)** | [**DONATE $5**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86631020/478494685/2105508926?amount=5&refcode=ea.9f5c0452-4427-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.9f5c0452-4427-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjlmNWMwNDUyLTQ0MjctZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=R0FMkKnruWySuSAbghUG9svb6DOiwjp6CW_6uzoHMEg=)

clean_body: There are some things money can’t buy, but for everything else... | It's Dan — Director of Organizing and Digital Engagement at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC! I have a question: What is it worth to you to elect bold climate champions, end the fossil fuel industry’s influence on our government, and ensure a livable, clean energy future for the generations to come? = I’ve long been inspired by people who use their resources and their platforms to affect change in a way I could never imagine. People like Jane, who have been protesting and demonstrating longer than I’ve been alive. People like Nalleli Cobo, who have chosen to respond to the deadly health impacts of fossil fuel pollution with years of dedicated advocacy for countless frontline communities whose health is under threat every day merely for existing in a certain location. I know I probably sound like a Mastercard credit card commercial when I say this, but there are truly some things money can’t buy, like the inspiration, motivation, and persistence of my climate heroes. But the unfortunate reality is that when it comes to winning elections, money talks. = Here’s why your support today is crucial: $5 could be the difference between electing leaders who are ready to challenge the fossil fuel industry and those who continue to support harmful environmental policies. $5 could be the difference between having the resources to implement a robust field program that mobilizes pro-climate voters in competitive districts, and missing our chance to connect with those voters. $5 could be the difference between spreading the word about clean energy and climate justice, and letting Big Oil dominate the conversation. I know it may seem like a stretch to say any one of those things will actually be the deciding factor in any given race, but I’m really not exaggerating. This quarter alone, two of our endorsed climate champions won their races by shockingly small margins. Molly Cook is now headed towards her first full term as the first openly LGBTQ+ member of the Texas State Senate because she won by a margin of only 74 votes. And in Berkeley, Igor Tregub won his city council seat by less than 50 votes. With less than 5 months until Election Day, we have the opportunity now to come together and make sure that our climate champions have the resources they need to win in some very tough races. = | = = I can’t thank you enough, Dan Rowe Director of Organizing and Digital Engagement, Jane Fonda Climate PAC | = | = = Follow along: | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. Jane Fonda Climate PAC 600 Pennsylvania Ave SE #15180 Washington, DC 20003 United States

In a conversation he didn't know was being recorded, embattled Supreme Court Justice Samuel Alito shared his private belief that his movement's battle with secular forces in the country was a zero-sum contest of irreconcilable values.
"One side or the other is going to win," Alito says in the audio, recorded last Monday. Alito thought he was speaking with a fellow right-wing movement activist, but was in fact talking to progressive activist and journalist Lauren Windsor. "I mean, there can be a way of working -- a way of living together peacefully, but it's difficult, you know, because there are differences on fundamental things that really can't be compromised. It's not like you can split the difference."
Alito was responding to a question from Lauren Windsor, a progressive advocacy journalist and activist who regularly records conversations with Republicans and conservative movement leaders. The conversation happened at a reception for the Supreme Court Historical Society.
Windsor is my guest on the podcast Deconstructed this week, which posts today, as well as on [Breaking Points](https://substack.com/redirect/4f0eed3d-c5c9-4f94-b409-0d2b1adddbb5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). You can [find it here or by searching Deconstructed](https://substack.com/redirect/eb66a3a6-0b71-4351-be52-0e1b796bf951?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on any platform. (It takes about 15 minutes to populate to the various podcast platforms.) We're publishing the secret audio in partnership with Rolling Stone. You can also find the audios on [Windsor's Twitter feed](https://substack.com/redirect/105bc5e2-021d-47be-bf78-4ea9b2c5c6fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Feel free to forward this newsletter, and if you're not subscribed to it, [you can do that here. ](https://substack.com/redirect/3a820189-e274-4f03-93c5-d42c05f5e8d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
