Peter, _**Even though Arizona's Civil War-era total abortion ban has now been repealed, Arizonans still don't have reproductive freedom.**_ In our state, abortions continue to be banned after 15 weeks, with no exceptions for rape or incest. And patients may still see an interruption in reproductive care this summer because the GOP legislature neglected to add an emergency clause to the bill, meaning the repeal will take more than three months to go into effect. Across the country, the legal landscape is equally bleak. Florida recently enacted a six-week abortion ban, criminalizing the procedure before most people even know that they're pregnant. Nationwide, nearly one in five women lives in a state with an abortion ban. **If one thing is clear, it's that we need reproductive champions like Yass at every level of government. With Republicans talking about a national abortion ban, the fight for federal protections is urgent.** That's why Yassamin has a comprehensive plan to protect reproductive rights in Arizona and nationwide. What does that mean? Is _abuse_ grounds for a biblical divorce? I address this and more in the series we are going through at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=11631036.5965.1.2a530e37aca0590ada3b74d771550ec1) over the[Gospel of Matthew](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=11631036.5966.1.5df248ba9260777480537da38f7cfe90). Watch [Matthew Pt. 9 - SEX, MARRIAGE + DIVORCE](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=11631036.5967.1.4447567b2e55a8a5a5407cf968dcd797) here: [https://youtube.com/live/QBndJugRbTo](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=11631036.5968.1.46c410eade066379ab710be0f8379e8f) Thank you,

subject: Exciting news with just 2 weeks left!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
Our spot on the Illinois ballot is at stake.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_ba_2_weeks_left&n=1)
---
Peter, We have just 2 weeks left to submit over 25,000 valid signatures to get on the ballot in Illinois. **This is one of our most difficult challenges** on the road to nationwide ballot access - and**we might not make it unless everyone pitches in now.** **Whether you can collect signatures, make a donation, or help some other way, please let us know now!**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ilballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_ba_2_weeks_left&n=2 "HELP JILL GET ON THE IL BALLOT") [HELP JILL GET ON THE IL BALLOT](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ilballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_ba_2_weeks_left&n=2)
---
We have a lot of work to do to clear the hurdle in Illinois - but **I have some exciting news to share.** I’ve been campaigning in Illinois for the last few days, and the response has been incredible. One of the standout events in our jam-packed schedule was a meeting in Chicago with community organizers from Breaking Barriers Mentoring. After a lively conversation about the election, politics, and issues from universal healthcare and rent control to reparations, some of these powerhouse activists shared that _they never actually felt they had a reason to vote before now_ \- **but now they’re ready to go all out for our campaign and help us collect the thousands of signatures we need!**
---
---
Unlike some of the professional petitioning firms that do paid petitioning around the country for candidates and issues across the political spectrum, these are deep-rooted community activists representing working-class and low-income communities whose residents are mostly Black and people of color. They’re ready to put their formidable organizing skills to work collecting the signatures we need in their neighborhoods around Chicago. Now we just have to raise the money to offer them fair and just compensation for this critical work. **Will you pitch in whatever you can now to help us move forward with these powerhouse community organizers who are ready to get us on the ballot in Illinois?**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/illinois?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_ba_2_weeks_left&n=3 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/illinois?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_ba_2_weeks_left&n=3)
---
On the campaign trail, we're hearing loud and clear that more and more people are _done_ with the false choice of Biden/Trump, and there’s a growing understanding that ours is the one anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate action campaign with a realistic chance of being on the ballot in every state across the country. Earning ballot access nationwide would give us the power to make our challenge to empire and oligarchy as strong as possible - **but it all depends on our ability to mobilize _now_ to go all out in Illinois for the next two weeks.** **Please do whatever you can now to make sure we get on the Illinois ballot and stay on track to give _every single voter_ a real choice for people, planet, and peace!**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ilballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_ba_2_weeks_left&n=4 "HELP JILL GET ON THE IL BALLOT") [HELP JILL GET ON THE IL BALLOT](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ilballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_ba_2_weeks_left&n=4)
---
Please share this urgent message with your friends, family, and fellow activists. We can do this if we all work together - but we need _everyone_ to answer the call. Thank you for everything you do to fight for an America and a world that works for all of us! **Gratitude and solidarity!** Jill Stein

Whether you can collect signatures, make a donation, or help some other way, please let us know now! | "HELP JILL GET ON THE IL BALLOT" We have a lot of work to do to clear the hurdle in Illinois - but I have some exciting news to share. I’ve been campaigning in Illinois for the last few days, and the response has been incredible. One of the standout events in our jam-packed schedule was a meeting in Chicago with community organizers from Breaking Barriers Mentoring. After a lively conversation about the election, politics, and issues from universal healthcare and rent control to reparations, some of these powerhouse activists shared that they never actually felt they had a reason to vote before now \- but now they’re ready to go all out for our campaign and help us collect the thousands of signatures we need! Unlike some of the professional petitioning firms that do paid petitioning around the country for candidates and issues across the political spectrum, these are deep-rooted community activists representing working-class and low-income communities whose residents are mostly Black and people of color. They’re ready to put their formidable organizing skills to work collecting the signatures we need in their neighborhoods around Chicago. Now we just have to raise the money to offer them fair and just compensation for this critical work. Will you pitch in whatever you can now to help us move forward with these powerhouse community organizers who are ready to get us on the ballot in Illinois? | "DONATE NOW" On the campaign trail, we're hearing loud and clear that more and more people are done with the false choice of Biden/Trump, and there’s a growing understanding that ours is the one anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate action campaign with a realistic chance of being on the ballot in every state across the country. Earning ballot access nationwide would give us the power to make our challenge to empire and oligarchy as strong as possible - but it all depends on our ability to mobilize now to go all out in Illinois for the next two weeks. Please do whatever you can now to make sure we get on the Illinois ballot and stay on track to give every single voter a real choice for people, planet, and peace! | "HELP JILL GET ON THE IL BALLOT" Please share this urgent message with your friends, family, and fellow activists. We can do this if we all work together - but we need everyone to answer the call. Thank you for everything you do to fight for an America and a world that works for all of us! Gratitude and solidarity! Jill Stein | "DONATE" Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024 ©2024 Jill Stein for President 2024, all rights reserved Jill Stein for President, www.jillstein2024.com P.O. name: Michael B. Moore for South Carolina
subject: "On Message" From Michael B. Moore
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
On Message
from Michael B. Moore
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Welcome to our campaign newsletter.
We're happy you're here.
We're using this space to keep you updated on all the latest stories, events, and opportunities related to Michael's run for South Carolina's 1st Congressional District.
Stay tuned — we'll be in your inbox every Monday.
See you on the trail.
Join our movement [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
On the calendar
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Early voting [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid023iqvoZ1fCkRKmTpPD54zAwkza9MrktAupnUnCtzyzVCuSQuxAb1Xv4zuSd3vxDRBl] kicked off last Tuesday and continues through this Friday, June 7!
Lowcountry Democrats deserve a nominee in SC-01 who can balance budgets, bridge divides, and bring home results for working families. So get out and cast a ballot for Michael today!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Happy Pride Month [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid02VQaiFZBx8VD1wsWuFzTqrpaH6gKXtsnivB4rqyW4V5FzZujU5Rqzpfb1W5DmTUJjl] , SC-01!
Members of the LGBTQI+ community are a valued part of the Lowcountry's culture, and Michael is committed to delivering for them and their families in Congress.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
It's also Gun Violence Awareness Month [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid0qhsJMY8bPFZwFf7zLnD9aw27j5YGJAKypz591Y56TTzexTjYvoTkHKW5Zj1KaHEil] — a time to recommit ourselves to ending America's scourge of senseless gun deaths.
In Congress, Michael will champion policies like universal background checks and red flag laws to better protect the families of SC-01.
In the news
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Our campaign earned the endorsement of Charles Brave [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid0eZLqr3BVvFsp9Ho2GKJeBjhpoqdKVg6LQYG2jiBtDZe553kLZ3a5Gac6Mtco7f8tl] , president of ILA Local 1422!
Charles is a longtime labor leader and a champion for the Lowcountry's working families. We're proud to have his support in the race for SC-01.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
WCIV [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid0TayVNd4YdWUQCJAp5TqA6ZyQMXNpdMYB8gdwkYhPceNr2GTf76r8LmyvXbL5wL4vl] covered the American Federation of Government Employees' endorsement of our campaign!
Michael continues to win support from major labor groups like AFGE — because they know how hard he'll fight for working families in Congress.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Michael spoke to WACH [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/videos/372630582462996/] about the forthcoming statue of his great-great-grandfather, Robert Smalls, on the State House grounds.
Smalls believed everyone deserved "an equal chance in the battle of life," no matter their background. Now, Michael is committed to realizing Smalls' dream here in SC-01.
From the trail
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Thanks to the East Cooper Democrats [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid02e3RC43qzGoWzjowkt9eyRs4AP18UVjmkbZjveGg4xb87FN5D2G7LF5zXWrxbUfAvl] for inviting Michael to share his hopeful vision for the future of the Lowcountry at this candidate forum.
Michael believes we have a real shot at flipping this swing district — so it's critical that Democrats get out to vote early in our SC-01 primary!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Thanks to the Sigma Upsilon Omega Chapter of Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid0B7H6knJ5z4J5uUTiEuxXgjCHDkTQvTqMgNY4UmTuNf9JiYs9ZdxMy9Wm3XvU9C7Sl] for hosting an inclusive, insightful forum for candidates seeking public office across the Lowcountry.
As the proud son of an AKA, Michael was especially grateful for this opportunity to grow our grassroots movement!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
We all had a ton of fun — and even more fried fish — at this community lunch and meet-and-greet at Beautiful Island Square on Hilton Head Island [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid02DunJu8SZyBWh5crhYmDyhrG2KnfdWyq9gEzCnVJA4bb4ueCa64eysVSjVQLTLHUzl] !
Thanks for welcoming our team to this special place, where Lowcountry neighbors can laugh and break bread together.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
The HHP Moody Blues [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid0TMyo8DAffqgbumsgJw3buQoQS7C7t34yTMxnUog94bucU9Wzuz33DVVdFNQjSibHl] know how to throw one heck of a party! Thanks to Richard Hammes for rallying this standing-room-only crowd — and to Pat Dowey for hosting us in her beautiful home.
This engaged, passionate community is going to help us flip SC-01 in November!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
You know Team Moore made an appearance at the ILA Local 1422 fish fry [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid0JFWhAjeM8cHLoqVSmfiGTsmk3qXU9292c7Lg92Ryt5RVMBkzqbTtiP5D2gcoG8Ytl] !
We're so grateful to be endorsed by this Lowcountry labor group and its distinguished president, Charles Brave. Our campaign is all about delivering real results for the working families of SC-01.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
We had a fun morning walking in the annual Charleston Pride Parade [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid0ich66VZ857UZAXiaKqFJ9KkddXY6X7iwsNqWMssL3mminEavhFat82k7sC1QsRrel] with a few of our campaign fellows and the Charleston County Democratic Party!
Michael is focused on defending the fundamental freedoms of all folks across SC-01 — no matter where you come from, what you look like, or who you love.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Michael showed up for the Sea Islands candidate forum [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid0j2pzZkdWvUY99QQf7YcHaANqh2ZViSV2WchFPG5a66pUZkvBXvJTqCp1nSu6uFkdl] at Fields Farm Market!
In Congress, he'll deliver for our district's coastal communities and take decisive action to protect them from the damaging effects of climate change.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
What a wonderful service at Greater St. James Bethel AME Church [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid0U3xCyKxap8CEmi2xwAAEQ4z1DjBVca3dpJbSy2Mrv8B62DWKaS4NrKH9enB69Tcql] on Wadmalaw Island!
Thanks to Rev. William R. Jones and First Lady Mrs. Jones for your warm welcome on Sunday morning.
On our team
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
There's so much work to do, and we're only just getting started.
Join us in our fight to flip this swing district.
Together, we're going to build a brighter future for South Carolina.

We can’t let the summer slump set us back – especially after Trump’s Super PAC announced plans to spend $100 million. While our momentum has slowed, MAGA Republicans have taken the lead. Trump’s campaign raised over $141 million in May, including $52 million after his guilty verdict. They raised more than two times our entire cycle budget in a single month. clean_body: [] While our economy is flourishing with unemployment down and wages rising, many Americans are still struggling with high costs in essential areas like healthcare, education, childcare, elderly care, and housing. drbob.me/aboutbob [drbob.me/aboutbob] Help me get to Congress to nurture an economy that works for everyone , not just a few. Our grassroots campaign is funded solely by hardworking individuals - chipping in what they can when they can so I can join House Democrats who are working hard to find real solutions to serious housing problems. DONATE NOW [] Friends, With inflation below 3.5%, supply chains stabilized, wage growth normalizing, and interest rates soon to decrease, the time is ripe for policymakers to urgently focus on long-term solutions to the cost-of-living crisis. Envision a future where our economic successes also correlate with affordable housing. This would alleviate financial burdens and enhance citizens' economic well-being and happiness. The problem: Mortgage rates have surged, making homeownership seem unattainable. Rising borrowing costs make debt repayment more burdensome than ever before. The struggle is real. Solutions require leadership and political will. We can confront the housing crisis head-on by uniting at the local, state, and federal levels and collaborating with the public and private sectors. The problem may seem complicated, but the solution is based on simple supply-and-demand economics. Building five million units may seem daunting, but I want to raise all of our voices in Congress to get it done. Friends, will you join our fight? | Peter,

It all comes down to tomorrow...

I entered this races six months ago with one goal in mind: Work with President Donald J. Trump to secure the border, combat inflation, and restore America’s greatness.

Over the past three and a half years, we have watched our country be invaded by illegal immigrants, prices at the grocery store and gas pump skyrocket, and conservatives like you and me be politically targeted by a weaponized justice system.

This is not the America we know and love.

North Dakota needs a real America-First proven Republican fighter representing us in Congress who will work with President Trump to get the job done.

Maintaining the status quo is not an option. If we do nothing, we’ll lose our country and the Washington uniparty will continue to sell out our interests to the highest bidder.

Tomorrow is our opportunity to stand up and fight back... and that’s why I’m asking for your vote.

When elected to Congress, I will join the House Freedom Caucus, work with President Trump, and do whatever it takes to save America.

I will not vote to approve any budget that excludes funding for the border. I will not vote to approve any budget that sends BILLIONS of our hard-earned money to Ukraine.

I will not vote to approve any budget that puts America last.

This is our last chance to elect America-First conservatives to Congress who will stand strong against the corrupt Washington establishment.

Polls open in 12 hours. If you have not voted yet, I encourage you to get out and vote for me, Rick Becker, for Congress.

I hope I have earned your vote.

For Liberty,
